the assets of such Person is not less than the amount that will be required to pay the probable liability of such Person on its debts as they become absolute and matured. &#160;In computing the amount similar type and amount. &#160;No Issuing Bank shall have any obligation to issue any Letter of Credit unless (i) such Issuing Bank receives a LC Application at least three Business Days prior to the requested date of issuance; (ii) each LC Condition is satisfied, and (iii)&#160;if a Defaulting Lender exists, such Lender or Borrowers have entered into arrangements satisfactory to Agent and each Letter of Credit that any LC Condition has not been satisfied, such Issuing Bank shall have no obligation to issue the requested Letter of Credit (or any other Letter of Credit) until such notice is withdrawn in writing by that Lender or until Required Lenders have waived such condition in accordance with this Agreement (provided that this sentence shall not constitute a waiver of Borrowers&#39; right to cause the issuance of a Letter of Credit in accordance with this Agreement if, in fact, all LC Conditions are satisfied in connection therewith). &#160;Prior to receipt of any such notice, such Issuing Bank shall not be deemed to have knowledge of any failure of LC Conditions.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New &#8203;<font style="display:inline-block;height:0pt;width:100%;"></font></u>Resignation of Issuing Bank</u><u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">.</u><font style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:none;"> &#160;Any Issuing Bank may resign at any time upon five Business Days&#39; prior written notice to Agent and Borrower Agent. &#160;On the effective date of such resignation, such Issuing Bank shall have no further obligation to issue, amend, renew, extend or otherwise modify any Letter of Credit, but shall honor such Letter of Credit in accordance with its then existing obligations thereunder and shall continue to have the benefits of </font><b style="font-weight:bold;text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:none;">Sections 2.3</b><font style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:none;">, </font><b style="font-weight:bold;text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:none;">11.6</b><font style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:none;"> and </font><b style="font-weight:bold;text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:none;">13.2</b><font style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:none;"> with respect to any Letters of Credit issued or other actions taken while an Issuing Bank. &#160;Agent may appoint a replacement Issuing Bank (other than a Defaulting Lender) with the consent of such replacement Issuing Bank and, as long as no Default or Event of Default exists, such replacement shall be subject to the consent of Borrower Agent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed.</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt &#8203;<font style="display:inline-block;height:0pt;width:100%;"></font></u>Interest</u><u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">.</u></p><p &#8203;<font style="display:inline-block;height:0pt;width:100%;"></font></u>Rates and Payment of Interest</u><u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">.</u></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 72pt;">(a)<font style="display:inline-block;width:23.79pt;"></font>The Obligations shall bear interest (i) if a Base Rate Loan, at the Base Rate in effect from time to time plus the Applicable Margin; (ii) if a <a name="_cp_change_1477"></a><font style="text-decoration-color:#0000ff;">Daily SOFR</font> Loan (other than an Alternate Swingline Loan), at <a name="_cp_change_1479"></a><font style="text-decoration-color:#0000ff;">Daily Simple SOFR</font> plus the Applicable Margin; (iii) if an Alternate Swingline Loan, at the Alternate Currency Rate plus the Applicable Margin; and (iv) if any other Obligation (including, to the extent permitted by law, interest not paid when due), at the Base Rate in effect from time to time plus the Applicable Margin for Base Rate Revolver Loans. &#160;Interest shall accrue from the date the Loan is advanced or the Obligation is incurred or payable, until paid by Borrowers. &#160;If a Loan is repaid on the same day made, one day&#39;s interest shall accrue.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 72pt;">(b)<font style="display:inline-block;width:23.17pt;"></font>During the continuance of an Event of Default, if Required Lenders in their discretion so elect, the Obligations shall bear interest at the Default Rate; <u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">provided</u>, <u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">however</u> that, at all times during the continuance of an Event of Default resulting from a default in the payment of principal of the Loans when and as required to be paid (whether at stated maturity, on demand, upon acceleration or otherwise), the Obligations shall bear interest at the Default Rate. &#160;Each Borrower acknowledges that the cost and expense to Agent and each Lender due to an Event of Default are difficult to ascertain and that the Default Rate is a fair and reasonable estimate to compensate Agent and Lenders for such added cost and expense.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt &#8203;<font style="display:inline-block;height:0pt;width:100%;"></font></u>Maximum Interest</u>. &#160;Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in any Credit Document, the interest paid or agreed to be paid under the Credit Documents shall not exceed the maximum rate of non-usurious interest permitted by Applicable Law (the &quot;<u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">Maximum Rate</u>&quot;). &#160;If Agent or any Lender shall receive interest in an amount that exceeds the Maximum Rate, the excess interest shall be applied to the principal of the Loans or other applicable Obligations (other than Bank Product Indebtedness) then due or, if it exceeds such unpaid principal, refunded to Borrowers. &#160;In determining whether the interest contracted for, charged or received by Agent or a Lender exceeds the Maximum Rate, such Person may, to the extent permitted by Applicable Law, (a) characterize any payment that is not principal as an expense, fee or premium rather than interest, (b) exclude voluntary prepayments and the effects thereof, and (c) amortize, prorate, allocate and spread, in equal or unequal parts, the total amount of interest throughout the contemplated term of the Obligations hereunder.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 0pt;"><font style="display:inline-block;text-align:left;text-indent:0pt;width:72pt;"><font style="font-family:'Times New &#8203;<font style="display:inline-block;height:0pt;width:100%;"></font></u>Manner of Borrowing and Funding Revolver Loans</u><u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;"><a name="_cp_change_1618"></a></u><u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;"><a name="_Toc506212156"></a><a name="_Toc506212447"></a><a name="_Toc506212736"></a><a style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;"><u style="display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;position:relative;text-align:justify;text-align-last:justify;text-decoration:underline;text-indent:0pt;vertical-align:bottom;white-space:normal;width:11.25pt;">&#8203; &#8203;<font style="display:inline-block;height:0pt;width:100%;"></font></u>Notice of Borrowing</u><u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">.</u></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 72pt;">(a)<font style="display:inline-block;width:23.79pt;"></font>Whenever Borrowers desire funding of a Borrowing of any Loans, Borrower Agent shall give Agent a Notice of Borrowing. &#160;Such notice must be received by Agent no later than 1:00 p.m. (i) on the Business Day of the requested funding date, in the case of Base Rate Loans <a name="_cp_change_1620"></a><font style="text-decoration-color:#0000ff;">and Daily SOFR</font> Loans (other than Alternate Swingline Loans), and (<a name="_cp_change_1622"></a><font style="text-decoration-color:#0000ff;">ii</font>)&#160;at least three Business Days prior to the requested funding date, in the case of Alternate Swingline Loans. &#160;Notices received after 1:00 p.m. shall be deemed received on the next Business Day. &#160;Each Notice of Borrowing (including any telephonic notice thereof, any notice given via electronic mail and any notice submitted through Agent&#39;s website) shall be irrevocable and shall specify (A) the principal amount of the Borrowing, (B) the requested funding date (which must be a Business Day), (C) whether the Borrowing is of Revolver Loans or FILO Loans; provided that such Borrowing shall be Revolver Loans unless the outstanding principal amount of FILO Loans is less than the FILO Maximum Amount, in which case up to an amount equal to the FILO Maximum Amount minus the outstanding principal amount of FILO Loans of such Loans shall be FILO Loans, and the remaining amount of such Loans shall be Revolver Loans, (D) whether the Borrowing is to be made as Base Rate Loans or <a name="_cp_change_1624"></a><font style="text-decoration-color:#0000ff;">Daily SOFR Loans, (E)</font> whether such Loan is a General Revolver Loan or a Distribution Revolver Loan, and (<a name="_cp_change_1626"></a><font style="text-decoration-color:#0000ff;">F</font>) if such Loan is to be a General Revolver Loan and is to be funded as a Swingline Loan in an Alternate Currency, the Alternate Currency in which such Loan is to be funded.</p></div><div style="clear:both;display:table;margin-bottom:30pt;min-height:21.6pt;width:100%;"><div style="display:table-cell;vertical-align:bottom;width:100%;"><p style="font-family:'Times New style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-variant:small-caps;">AMERICAS/2024146412.5</font></p></div></div></div><hr payment is otherwise timely made by Borrowers, the becoming due of any Obligations (whether principal, interest, fees or other charges, including Extraordinary Expenses <a name="_cp_change_1629"></a><font style="text-decoration-color:#0000ff;">and</font> LC Obligations<a name="_cp_change_1630"></a><font style="text-decoration-color:#0000ff;"> but excluding, for the avoidance of doubt</font>, Cash Collateral and Bank Product Indebtedness) shall be deemed irrevocably to be a request (without any requirement for a Notice of Borrowing) for Base Rate Loans on the due date, in the amount of such Obligations;&#160; provided that such Loans shall be Revolver Loans unless the outstanding principal amount of FILO Loans is less than the FILO Maximum Amount, in which case up to an amount equal to the FILO Maximum Amount minus the outstanding principal amount of FILO Loans of such Loans shall be FILO Loans, and the remaining amount of such Loans shall be Revolver Loans. &#160;The proceeds of such Loans shall be disbursed as direct payment of the relevant Obligation.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 72pt;">(c)<font style="display:inline-block;width:23.79pt;"></font>If Borrowers establish a controlled disbursement account with Agent or any Affiliate of Agent, then the presentation for payment of any check or other item of payment drawn on such account at a time when there are insufficient funds to cover it shall be deemed to be a request (without any requirement for a Notice of Borrowing) for Base Rate Revolver Loans or Base Rate FILO Loans, as applicable, on the date of such presentation; in the amount of the check and items presented for payment provided that such Loans shall be Revolver Loans unless the outstanding principal amount of FILO Loans is less than the FILO Maximum Amount, in which case up to an amount equal to the FILO Maximum Amount minus the outstanding principal amount of FILO Loans of such Loans shall be FILO Loans, and the remaining amount of such Loans shall be Revolver Loans. &#160;The proceeds of such Loans may be disbursed directly to the controlled disbursement account.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:11pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12pt 72pt;">(d)<font style="display:inline-block;width:23.17pt;"></font>Neither Agent nor any Lender shall have any obligation to Borrowers to honor any deemed request for a Loan (i) on or after the Revolver Commitment Termination Date or FILO Termination Date, as applicable, (ii) when an Overadvance exists or would result therefrom, or (iii)&#160;when any condition in <b style="font-weight:bold;">Section 6</b> is not satisfied, but may do so in their discretion, without being deemed to have waived any Default or Event of Default (provided that Borrowers shall not be deemed to have made any representation or warranty that such conditions in <b style="font-weight:bold;">Section 6</b> are satisfied in connection with any such deemed request (as opposed to any actual request) for Loans).</p><p style="font-family:'Times New &#8203;<font style="display:inline-block;height:0pt;width:100%;"></font></u>Fundings by Lenders</u><u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;">.</u><font style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:none;"> &#160;Each Revolver Lender shall timely honor its Revolver Commitment by funding its Pro Rata share of each Borrowing of Revolver Loans that is properly requested hereunder. &#160;Each FILO Lender shall timely honor its FILO Commitment by funding its Pro Rata share of each Borrowing of FILO Loans that is properly requested hereunder</font><u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;"><a name="_9kMH7O6ZWu8GD79F"></a></u><font style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:none;">.</font><font style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:none;"> Agent shall use commercially reasonable efforts to notify Lenders of each Notice of Borrowing (or deemed request for a Borrowing) by 2:00 p.m. on the proposed funding date for Base Rate Loans or </font><u style="text-decoration-color:#000000;text-decoration-line:underline;text-decoration-style:solid;"><a name="_cp_change_1632"></a></u><font such Lender&#39;s Pro Rata share of the Borrowing to the account specified by Agent in immediately available funds not later than 4:00 p.m. on the requested funding date, unless Agent&#39;s notice is received after the times provided above, in which event Lender shall fund its Pro Rata share by 1:00 p.m. on the next Business Day. &#160;Subject to its receipt of such amounts from Lenders, Agent shall make available the proceeds of the Loans as directed by Borrower Agent. &#160;Unless Agent shall have received (in sufficient time to act) written notice from a Lender that it does not intend to fund its Pro Rata share of a Borrowing, Agent may assume that such Lender has deposited or promptly will deposit its share with Agent, and Agent may disburse a corresponding amount to Borrowers. &#160;If a Lender&#39;s share of any Borrowing is not in fact received by Agent, then Borrowers agree to repay to Agent on demand the amount of such share, together with interest thereon from the date disbursed until repaid, at the rate applicable to such Borrowing.</font></p></div><div style="clear:both;display:table;margin-bottom:30pt;min-height:21.6pt;width:100%;"><div Obligations by Obligors shall be made without deduction or withholding of any Taxes, except as required by Applicable Law. &#160;If Applicable Law (as determined in the good faith discretion of an applicable &#160;Withholding Agent) requires the deduction or withholding of any Tax from any such payment by a Withholding Agent, then the applicable Withholding Agent shall be entitled to make such deduction or withholding based on information and documentation provided pursuant to <b style="font-weight:bold;">Section 5.9</b>.</p><p style="font-family:'Times New amount withheld or deducted to the relevant Governmental Authority in accordance with Applicable Law, and (ii) if the Taxes are Indemnified Taxes, then the sum payable by the applicable Obligor shall be increased as necessary so that, after such deduction or withholding has been made (including such deductions and withholdings applicable to additional amounts payable under this Section) the
